metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email after the log-writing fixes (#135): log lines and changelog entries name the user, run headings go directly above the previous newest run, About me notes are recorded in the changelog, no log line holds an ID number (including one in a copied subject), the Labels table covers every AI/ label in the account, and a new reply's earlier messages are read for the user's tab. Evals 1-31, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as of commit 0cce083, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR. Runs were on 2026-10-25 in the rubric timezone; fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 and shifted two weeks. Failures: the user's first-person voice in a changelog entry copied from user-voiced rubric wording (evals 30 and 31, run 2); eval 18 run 2 (appended a second copy of the log template at the end of the doc after a search read of the log came back empty, so the run heading sat under the copy); eval 7 run 1 (an About me note recorded how the user treats a sender's priority, which the grader counted as a learned rule). Not graded: ID numbers in a few log lines outside eval 23 (eval 3 run 2 reason, eval 21 run 2 subject); run headings sometimes placed above the Runs intro; log thread lines without the list marker and changelog entries using 'date:' instead of 'date |'; unused category labels created up front.
